title: Registration and approval
text: Run yoke machines pending on a connected machine, compare the four-character terminal code and displayed identity, then approve your own machine with yoke machines approve CODE or refuse it with yoke machines deny CODE. The engine owns decisions and one-time credentials. Hosted routing hands a preissued code into the selected organization through service-only handoff and polling. A local universe explains that other computers cannot connect. Source adoption is observed; production delivery remains unverified.
